requirements.requirement: The system must return an insufficiency response when fewer than 3 valid measures are provided to the scoring engine in unit tests.
The system must return a valid score output when 3 or more valid measures are provided to the scoring engine in unit tests.
The system must treat exactly 3 valid measures as sufficient and return a score in unit tests.
The system must exclude null or invalid measures from the valid measure count during unit tests.
The system must return an insufficiency response when total measures >=3 but valid measures <3 due to invalid or null entries.
The system must include valid_measure_count and required_minimum fields in insufficiency responses validated in unit tests.
The system must not invoke score calculation logic when the valid measure count is below 3, verified via unit test assertions or mocks.
The system must propagate insufficiency responses unchanged through the EvaluateCare facade in integration tests.
The system must return a score response through the EvaluateCare facade when valid measure count is 3 or greater in integration tests.
The system must handle empty measure input by returning an insufficiency response in unit tests.
The system must handle malformed measure input structures without crashing and return an insufficiency response in unit tests.
The system must ensure integration tests validate end-to-end behavior from API facade input to final response type (score vs insufficiency).
